**26 plugins** (was 10), **real audio effects**, and **six waveform styles**.

## New: effects that change the sound
- **Equalizer** — 5 bands (low shelf, 3 bells, high shelf). Drag the nodes over the live spectrum, scroll on a node for Q, double-click to reset.
- **Compressor** — threshold, ratio, attack, release, makeup; transfer curve with the live signal on it and a gain-reduction meter.
- **Maximizer** — look-ahead limiter: drive into a ceiling, scrolling gain-reduction history.

Effects run in slot order (drag slots to reorder the chain) and before the meters, so every analyzer shows the processed sound. Each effect has a power button in its header; settings are remembered.

## New analysis
- **Tempo (BPM)** with a beat display, **Key** with Camelot code and live chromagram, **Pitch / Tuner**
- **Tonal Balance** against a reference range for modern mixes, **Stereo Imager** (width from sub to air, warns about wide bass)
- **True Peak & Clips** (4x oversampled), **Dynamics** (crest factor and PLR)
- **Waterfall 3D**

## New just for fun
Radial Spectrum, Particles, Cover Glow (takes its colours from the album art), Vinyl Deck (cover as label, arm follows the song), Tape Reels.

## Waveform styles
Right-click the waveform: Bars, Mirror, Reflection, Line, Spectral colour, 3-Band. The colour styles come from a background analysis of the whole track.

## Downloads
| Platform | File | How to start |
|---|---|---|
| Windows 10/11 (64-bit) | `Transport-Windows-x64.exe` | Just run it, nothing to install. SmartScreen: *More info → Run anyway* (not code-signed yet). |
| macOS 11+ (Apple Silicon & Intel) | `Transport-macOS.zip` | Unzip, right-click → **Open** the first time (not notarised yet). |
| Linux x64 | `Transport-Linux-x64.tar.gz` | Extract and run `./Transport`. |

## Tested
Unit tests on Windows, macOS and Linux cover EBU R128 loudness, FFT, stereo maths, tempo (92/124/140 BPM within 0.2 BPM), key (C major, G major, A minor, E minor progressions), true peak, band width, EQ gain, compressor ratio and the limiter ceiling.
